outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 160 pregnant women divided into two groups: a control group with gestational age 37-40 weeks and a study group with gestational age >40 weeks.
finding: Post-term pregnancy was associated with higher rates of cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, sepsis, intrapartam asphyxia, neonatal intensive care unit admission, and intrauterine fetal death.
mod_finding: The study did not report specific findings related to mode of birth, although cesarean section rates were higher in the post-term group.
